briefing: Markets are in risk-on mode with NASDAQ +1.2% and S&P 500 +1.1%. With cash above the $500 threshold and an open slot, we added MRNA, which shows full multi-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above SMA-20, volume surge) with less speculative risk than the micro-cap names topping the screener.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, based on the idea that strong recent performance tends to continue in the near term. Today's buy in MRNA was chosen because it showed multiple confirming signals — rising price, a bullish MACD crossover, and strong volume — all pointing the same direction.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入已經呈上升趨勢的股票，原理是近期表現強勁的股份短期內傾向延續升勢。今日選擇買入MRNA，正是因為它同時出現多個確認訊號——股價上升、MACD出現黃金交叉，以及成交量放大，方向一致。

market_education.summary_en: Broad market strength today lifted both the NASDAQ (+1.2%) and S&P 500 (+1.1%), with technology and growth names leading gains as investor risk appetite improved. The rally was broad-based rather than driven by a single catalyst, reflecting generally supportive conditions for equities. Volume surges across several momentum names suggest institutional participation rather than isolated speculative moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市造好，納指升1.2%，標普500升1.1%，科技及增長股領漲，反映投資者風險胃納回升。今次升勢屬全面性，並非單一消息帶動，顯示整體市況對股市有利。多隻具動能個股成交量顯著放大，反映機構資金參與，而非個別散戶炒作。

trades.reasoning: All four bullish signals confirmed (MACD crossover, RSI 63.3 in bullish zone, price above SMA-20, volume surge) on a risk-on day, with better liquidity/lower volatility than the micro-cap alternatives scoring the same.
